name: BASO Precision Optics Co., Ltd.
summary: BASO Precision Optics Co., LTD., established in 1959 and headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan, operates as a global producer and distributor of optical lenses. Their high-precision optics find applications across a diverse range of industries, including advanced projection systems, automated optical inspection (AOI), telescopes, semiconductor fabrication, sports equipment, laser-based technology, and anodized goods. In addition to its manufacturing activities, the company also offers expert consulting services for both domestic and international sales strategies, as well as manufacturing processes.
